each sym shuffle as s

"Open cards" count(open all) faint
button "Close all" tap remove all open

Match, in the plum colours.

- a button "Close all"; a tap removes all open entries, with one undo.

program:
app "Rent" home slate
table tenant name text, phone text?
table rent_entry tenant ref tenant, amount money, kind pick Due|Paid, due date?
"Rent owed" sum(rent_entry.amount where kind = Due) - sum(rent_entry.amount where kind = Paid) big
each tenant as p
  let bal = sum(p.rent_entry.amount where kind = Due) - sum(p.rent_entry.amount where kind = Paid)
  stack card tap edit p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      if(bal >= 0, "owes you", "paid ahead") abs(bal) color if(bal >= 0, good, bad)
    "Last entry" last(p.rent_entry.at) faint
form tenant, "Add tenant"
form rent_entry, "Add entry"
list rent_entry by day
describe:

- a list of rent entry by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

program:
app "Class timers Buddy" timer ink
table class name text, mins num 5..240 = 60
each class as c
  state left dur = c.mins * 1m
  state going bool = no
  every 1s if going set left = left - 1s
  when going and left <= 0s set going = no then notify c.name "class is over"
  row card gap 2
    draw width 40
      circle 50, 50, 40 fill if(going, good, soft)
    stack grow
      c.name bold
      left big
    button if(going, "Pause", "Start") tap set going = not going
    button "Reset" tap set going = no then set left = c.mins * 1m
form class, "Add class"
describe:
Class timers Buddy, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- class: name: text; mins: number, 5 to 240, starts at 60. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each class:
  - every 1 seconds while going, it sets left to left minus 1 seconds.
  - when going and left is at most 0 hours, it sets going to no, then shows the notice the name of the class, "class is over".
  - a drawing made of circles.
  - text: the name of the class.
  - text: left.
  - a button "Pause" when going, otherwise "Start"; a tap sets going to not going.
  - a button "Reset"; a tap sets going to no, then sets left to the mins of the class times 1 minute.
- a form to add a class.

program:
app "Bowling" ball ocean
table point team pick Lane_1|Lane_2, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Lane_1)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Lane_2)
setting winat num = 200 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Lane 1" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Lane_1, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Lane_1, pts = 5
  stack card grow align center
    "Lane 2" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Lane_2, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Lane_2, pts = 5
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Lane 1 win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Lane 2 win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Bowling, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Lane 1, Lane 2; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- a is the total pts of point where team is Lane 1.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Lane 2.
Shows:
- text: "Lane 1".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Lane 1, pts set to 1.
- a button "+5"; a tap adds a point with team set to Lane 1, pts set to 5.
- text: "Lane 2".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Lane 2, pts set to 1.
- a button "+5"; a tap adds a point with team set to Lane 2, pts set to 5.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Lane 1 win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Lane 2 win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

app "Credit" wallet slate
table customer name text, limit money
table entry customer ref customer, amount money, kind pick Took|Paid = Took
each customer sort name as c
  let bal = sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Took) - sum(c.entry.amount where kind = Paid)
  stack card gap 1 tap edit c
    row
      c.name bold grow
      bal bold color if(bal > c.limit, bad, ink)

    row gap 1

program:
app "Daily Wedding Budget" gift plum
table func name text, budget money
table expense func ref func, vendor text, amount money
table guest name text, side pick Bride|Groom, count num 1..20 = 1
when count(func, sum(it.expense.amount) > it.budget * 0.9) > 0 notify "A function passed 90 percent of its budget"
each func
  stack card gap 1
    row
      it.name head grow
      "left" it.budget - sum(it.expense.amount) bold color if(sum(it.expense.amount) > it.budget * 0.9, warn, good)
    goal sum(it.expense.amount), it.budget, "spent"
    each it.expense
      row
        it.vendor grow
        it.amount
form func, "Add function"
form expense, "Add expense"
"Guests" head
each guest by side
  stack card
    it.key sum(it.count) bold
    each it
      it.name
form guest, "Add guest"
describe:
Daily Wedding Budget, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- func: name: text; budget: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- expense: func: a func; vendor: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- guest: name: text; side: one of Bride, Groom; count: number, 1 to 20, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- when how many of the func have the total amount of its expense entries is more than its budget times 0.9 is more than 0, it shows the notice "A function passed 90 percent of its budget".
- for each func:
  - text: its name.
  - text: "left", its budget minus the total amount of its expense entries.
  - the total amount of its expense entries out of its budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
  - for each its expense:
    - text: its vendor.
    - text: its amount.
- a form to add a func.
- a form to add a expense.
- text: "Guests".
- for each group of guest entries by side:
  - text: its key, the total count of the group.
  - for each the group:
    - text: its name.
- a form to add a guest.
